answer_1.quote: We first evaluate the Tree-of-Traversals algorithm on two common tasks used for evaluating an LLM's knowledge: 2WikiMultiHop and QALD-10... We also evaluate on the newly created MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata dataset, reporting Exact Match scores for the generated answers.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answer strings produced by the LLM for each query

answer_2.quote: We use Exact Match Included (EM-in) as the evaluation metric. EM-in is 1 if the ground truth answer appears with an exact match anywhere in the answer and 0 otherwise.
